en: Colorized view of a hill covered in greenery with historic buildings. Dominating the right side is a square stone clock tower with large clock faces and a steep, dark roof, known as the Uhrturm. To the left are additional buildings with red-tiled roofs. At the top left of the image, red printed text reads 'Graz. Uhrturm.' The style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century tourism postcard.
